concept: Review and integration: leadership as service to the group, not authority over it
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across fair decisions, motivating others, and delivering hard news — which comes least naturally to you?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real group or team where they could practice this Pillar

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
